The Company is revising its previously issued fiscal 2026 financial outlook to reflect the greater-than-anticipated impact of historical assortment decisions on revenue performance.

While the Company continues to see encouraging improvements in the productivity and reorder eligibility of products introduced in 2026, the impact of weaker prior-year product offerings became more pronounced in the second half of the year, and the Company does not expect meaningful improvements in that trend before year-end.

Accordingly, the Company expects continued year-over-year revenue pressure in the fourth quarter, comparable to the third quarter, with full-year revenue and Adjusted EBITDA below previously communicated expectations.
The Company now expects capital expenditures to be between $1.5 million and $2.0 million, inclusive of capitalized software, favorable to 2025 levels.

Looking ahead to fiscal 2027, the Company expects the year-over-year rate of revenue decline to moderate as the improving performance of products introduced in 2026 contributes more meaningfully to reorder activity and helps offset the continued impact of weaker historical product offerings.
The Company also expects continued strong growth in its wholesale channel to support overall revenue performance.
